item: Many files were changed within seconds. Check whether a backup, archive extraction or installer explains it; if not, isolate the machine.
Files were renamed in bulk, often with a new extension. Compare the new extensions with known ransomware extensions.
The most active program runs from a non-standard location. Verify its path, publisher and parent process.
Investigate the suspect process 'python.exe' (it is a best guess based on activity, not proof).
Disconnect the affected machine from the network to stop any spread.
Do not delete or modify the original files; the quarantine folder holds copies.
Restore affected files from a clean backup after the cause is understood.
